_comment: Timed events online, the same for everyone. Each weekly event starts on a day of the week (1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday) at an hour in UTC and lasts `hours`. Effects: baron_loot multiplies what robber baron camps drop. An event with `invasion` puts invader camps near every castle while it runs: `camps` of them (named from `names`), the first at level 1 + `level_per_keep` per keep level above 1 and each next one a level higher. Every win raises an invader camp a level and gives `points_per_level` event points for each level it had; a beaten camp rebuilds for `rebuild` seconds.

weekly.name: Baron Invasion
weekly.description: Invader camps have appeared near your castle. Beat them for event points.
